## Housing Stability Notification Act

**Operative Obligation:**

citations.cited_text:
Housing Stability Notification Act
The Housing Stability Notification Act requires any landlord to provide renters with a Notice of Tenant’s Rights and Resources when planning to end a tenancy agreement.

Landlord Requirements
The Housing Stability Notification Act requires
ALL LANDLORDS
planning to end a tenancy agreement to provide the tenant with a Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources.

content.text: The Housing Stability Notification Act requires any landlord to provide renters with a Notice of Tenant's Rights and Resources when planning to end a tenancy agreement.

citations.cited_text:
Step 1
Notify the Tenant:
The Notice of Tenants’ Rights and Resources should be delivered at the same time as the Notice to quit or Notice of non-renewal of lease.

content.text: The Notice of Tenants' Rights and Resources should be delivered at the same time as the Notice to quit or Notice of non-renewal of lease.

citations.cited_text:
Step 2
Notify the City
: The Housing Stability Notification Act also requires landlords and foreclosing owners to complete the
Notice to Quit / Non-renewal of Lease Submission Verification Form
. Landlords must use this online form to provide tenant contact information and upload a copy of the Notice to Quit or Notice of Non-renewal of Lease.

content.text: The Housing Stability Notification Act also requires landlords and foreclosing owners to complete the Notice to Quit / Non-renewal of Lease Submission Verification Form, using an online form to provide tenant contact information and upload a copy of the Notice to Quit or Notice of Non-renewal of Lease.
